blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Almost a month after the first duly-elected Bangsamoro Parliament assumed office, the body finally approved the rules that will govern the parliamentary proceedings, its first major measure that will replace the rules and procedures practiced during the seven-year transition period. During its regular session on Tuesday, Nov. 24, the parliament approved Bangsamoro Parliament Resolution No. 01, a measure adopting the Standing Orders of the Bangsamoro Parliament. The adoption of the resolution fulfills the requirement mandated by Section 25, Article VII of the Bangsamoro Organic Law, which requires the Parliament to adopt its own rules for the conduct of […]...
